title: Pip Crosses the Pond
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 (Learning) — longer words with two sounds blended at the start (st, sw, tr), stretch practice.

pages.text: Pip must get across the pond.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing on the bank, looking across a round garden pond to the far side.

pages.text: Pip gets a flat stick to sit on.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pulling a long, flat stick to the edge of the pond.

pages.text: Pip sets off on the flat stick.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow balanced on the flat stick as it floats a little way out onto the pond.
The flat stick spinning and tipping on the water, Pip wobbling to stay on.

pages.text: Pip gets wet with a splash!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tumbling off the stick into the pond with a big splash.

pages.text: Pip gets up. Pip drips and drips.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing on the bank, feathers soaked and dripping.

pages.text: Pip gets a flat log next.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pulling a short, flat log to the edge of the pond instead.

pages.text: The log sits flat and still.
pages.illustration: The flat log floating steadily on the still water of the pond.

pages.text: Pip floats on the log, past the reeds.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow riding the floating log past a clump of tall green reeds at the edge of the pond.

pages.text: Pip gets to the grass, wet but glad.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow stepping off the log onto the grass on the far side of the pond, feathers damp but looking pleased.
